balanced: Minimize mean of four parent-relative validation MAE ratios, equal parent weights
full: Minimize frozen B12 validation MAE, transfer same chosen branch/weight to all ablations
invariant: One branch and weight per outer fold shared by B/B1/B2/B12. Parent contribution at least25%; no source refits or extra labels
acceptance: Unchanged all-three-dataset all-three-metric independent/incremental/complementarity gates. Report both policies; no datasetwise picking.
limits: Exploratory development following prior failure, not independent test
Ordinary fusion is not proven novel
